title: Administrative Office Wiretap Report — annual aggregate series
body: Public edition. Public legal record, fact-checked reference. Under 18 U.S.C. 2519, the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts publishes an annual Wiretap Report with aggregate counts of authorized wiretaps, pen registers, and related orders, including offense categories and costs. It is the longest-running public aggregate series on electronic surveillance authorizations in the United States. All figures are aggregates; no individual targets are identified. HARD PRIVACY BOUNDARY: this database contains LEGAL RECORDS ONLY (public court rulings, statutes, published policies, aggregate statistics). It never contains any real person's actual location data or private non-public personal location information.

These releases describe the scale of non-content record demands without identifying any subscriber. Researchers combine them with court dockets to track post-Carpenter shifts toward warrant-based CSLI process. title: California CalECPA annual reports — state aggregate series
citations: Cal. Penal Code 1546.4; CA AG CalECPA reports (published)
body: Public edition. Public legal record, fact-checked reference. CalECPA requires the California Attorney General to publish annual aggregate data on government requests for electronic communication information, including the number of requests, the legal process used, and whether notice was delayed. It is the leading state-level aggregate series on location-record demands under a warrant-default regime.
